# XChem-style fragment screening demo: automated lab proposal

## Executive summary

Modelled median throughput is 410.7 crystals_per_day against a requested 300 crystals_per_day.

These are model-based predictions, not measured throughput or safety certification.

Express soluble E. coli target in shake flasks, harvest cells, lyse/clarify, purify on column, QC/concentration, set crystallisation drops, grow and image crystals, select drops, soak fragments, manually harvest crystals with a Shifter (operator throughout), transfer filled pucks into a charged dry shipper, ship to external synchrotron for diffraction, in-silico hit analysis. No in-house X-ray. Target 300 crystals/day steady state, 10 m x 8 m room, USD 2,000,000 equipment budget, instruments 24 h/day, two skilled operators on 8 h shifts. BSL1; high-g centrifuges and cryogens need separated areas with ventilation/O2 monitoring.
